question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Considering".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Consider** is to carefully consider **something, to judge something to be something else, or to hold a certain** belief.
 
• Several companies around **the world**, especially those in the **information technology sector**, are thinking about **sticking with the hybrid approach**.
 
• In future, many **business** including **information technology** will consider **the work of hydrid model. **

**​Correct sentence: **In the future also, many businesses across the globe, including the information technology industry, are **considering__** continuing with the hybrid model.
